{{Quote|See if you can find Gordo Zek in the slave pens. He always knew what was going on.|[[Zorgom Z'all]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FC" />}}
'''Gordo Zek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Zek was captured by the [[Corellian slavers]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer infiltrated the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Incriminating Evidence|Corellia}}</ref> Gordo Zek agreed to help the spacer in the search of [[Neeka Z'all]], a little girl lost by her parent, [[Zorgom Z'all|Zorgom]] and [[Norith Z'all]], when they escaped the bunker. Thanks to the assistance of Gordo Zek, the spacer was able to rescue Neeka Z'all and the child eventually returned to her parents.<ref name="SWG:FC" /> The spacer also broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels,<ref name="SWG:IE" /> leading dozens of CorSec agents to quickly move to the slaver bunker and free all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Gordo Zek]]
Gordo Zek was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gordo Zek was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>

Because Gordo Zek spawned under the generic "commoner" template, his appearance was randomly generated among 120 possible appearances. This included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] of either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and male [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. However the quest dialogues identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG:FC" />
